description: Plan your training with ChatGPT and take it to the gym with Volm. Keep your workouts, programs, and training history in one place, giving ChatGPT the context to help you build a plan around your goals and schedule. Follow your workouts set by set in the Volm app, then review your progress with ChatGPT and adjust what comes next. Connect your Volm account for free.

defaultPrompt: Review my recent workouts and suggest what I should train next.
Log today's workout from my notes.
Build and schedule a four-day workout program for me.
